items.title: Angular SSR Request Vulnerability Allows Attackers to Trick Applications into Sending Unauthorized Requests
items.description: A critical vulnerability has been discovered in Angular Server-Side Rendering (SSR) that could allow attackers to trick applications into sending unauthorized requests. Tracked as CVE-2026-27739, this Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) flaw poses a severe risk to web applications using affected versions of the Angular framework.
